title: Blue Period
author: Tsubasa Yamaguchi
description: An aimless high school student discovers painting. Learning to see becomes inseparable from learning what he wants, and what he is willing to work for.

title: Chainsaw Man
author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
description: Denji wants a simple life. A debt, a devil and a desperate deal make that more complicated than it sounds. A jagged mix of horror, absurd comedy and loneliness.

title: Dandadan
author: Yukinobu Tatsu
description: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. Neither expects to be right at the same time. Occult encounters and adolescent awkwardness collide at full speed.

title: Death Note
author: Tsugumi Ohba / Takeshi Obata
description: Light Yagami finds a notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written inside. His use of it draws the attention of the detective L.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
author: Hiromu Arakawa
description: Two brothers search for a way to restore their bodies after an alchemical experiment goes wrong. The cost of their search reaches far beyond their own lives.

title: Naruto
author: Masashi Kishimoto
description: Naruto Uzumaki trains as a ninja and pursues his goal of becoming the leader of his village.

title: One Piece
author: Eiichiro Oda
description: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail to find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates. An expanding world of impossible islands, found family and inherited dreams.

title: Witch Hat Atelier
alternateTitle: とんがり帽子のアトリエ
author: Kamome Shirahama
description: Coco has always believed magic belongs to the gifted. A glimpse of a forbidden secret changes what she knows and sends her into an intricate world of ink and spells.
